text:
Alex: Evening handoff - quick runthrough before I log off.
Priya: thanks alex. quick q: did the canary finish for the embed model update?
Alex: Canary finished ~30m ago. No errors in the canary logs but perf was ~7% worse on long tails (seq>1024). We rolled back the canary variant to v2b and left v2a active.
Mateo: noted. which hosts were in the canary pool?
Alex: eu-west-1-gpu-{02,05,09} and us-west-2-gpu-07.
Jordan: FYI, dedicated pool maintenance scheduled tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. That might reduce capacity for burst routing.
Samira: added to watchlist. Any autoscale knobs to bump before maintenance?
Alex: I increased dedicated pool min replicas by +2 for the night; autoscaler still active. Watch token queue for spikes.
Priya: there's been a small uptick in prefix cache evictions on the redis tier, maybe due to greater concurrency.
Mateo: logs show TTL evictions spiking at 01:40 UTC. Could be batch job overlap.
Alex: yep — nightly prefetch job (prefetcher v1.4) kicks at 01:35 UTC, might be thrashing storage. I queued a follow-up to move it 01:00 in cron.
OncallBot: Deployment notice: rolling deploy to prod of prefetcher v1.4 will start at 2026-03-19T01:00:00Z (triggered by @Alex). See /deploys/5678
Jordan: small ops note: if you see increased latency for embeddings, fallback policy should route to smaller quantized model (embed-quant-small) automatically — only exception: requests with pinned model header.
Samira: pinging eng-ml for additional perf investigation tomorrow. @Priya can you capture a couple of failing request ids if you see them?
Priya: will do. also a heads-up — two PRs need reviews before EOD: #4328 (prefetcher cron shift) and #4331 (cache TTL tweak). quick thumbs appreciated.
Mateo: I'll take #4328.
Jordan: I'll grab #4331 after triage.
Alex: action items for night team: 1) watch embed latency on seq>1024, 2) monitor dedicated pool capacity during 02:00 window, 3) check redis evictions trend and open ticket if sustained, 4) merge + deploy prefetcher cron after approvals.
Samira: added checkboxes to the handoff doc and linked to runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/prefetcher
OncallBot: Reminder: scheduled global SLO report will run at 03:15 UTC. If anomalies detected, incident-sev1 channel auto-creates.
Alex: I'm signing off in 20m. Leave escalations to Mateo for infra, Jordan for routing, Samira for perf.
Priya: thanks — leaving a quick note in the calendar: oncall handover 23:45 UTC.
Mateo: cheers, will watch the queues. ping me on slack if anything spikes.
Jordan: +1, I'll be around for the dedicated maintenance window.
Samira: good handoff, thanks Alex. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks team — see you tomorrow.
